python3 -c "
import json, glob, numpy as np
from collections import defaultdict

base_dir = '/root/autodl-tmp/gen-depth-contamination/outputs/exp006'
results = defaultdict(lambda: {'mmlu': [], 'hellaswag': []})
seed_data = {}

for f in sorted(glob.glob(f'{base_dir}/*/eval_results.json')):
    with open(f) as fp:
        data = json.load(fp)
    run_name = f.split('/')[-2]
    scores = data.get('scores', {})
    mmlu = scores.get('mmlu', {}).get('acc,none')
    hs = scores.get('hellaswag', {}).get('acc_norm,none')
    
    parts = run_name.rsplit('_s', 1)
    strategy = parts[0] if len(parts) == 2 and parts[1].isdigit() else run_name
    seed = parts[1] if len(parts) == 2 and parts[1].isdigit() else 'N/A'
    
    if mmlu is not None: results[strategy]['mmlu'].append(mmlu)
    if hs is not None: results[strategy]['hellaswag'].append(hs)
    seed_data[run_name] = {'mmlu': mmlu, 'hs': hs, 'strategy': strategy, 'seed': seed}

print('=== SUMMARY (mean +/- std) ===')
print(f'{\"Strategy\":<25} {\"n\":>3}  {\"MMLU\":>13}  {\"HellaSwag\":>13}')
print('-'*60)
for key in ['base_model', 'no-filter', 'binary-ours', 'binary-drayson', 'surprisal', 'graduated_a0.1', 'graduated_a0.3', 'graduated_a0.5', 'graduated_a0.7', 'graduated_a0.9']:
    if key in results:
        m = results[key]['mmlu']
        h = results[key]['hellaswag']
        n = len(m)
        print(f'{key:<25} {n:>3}  {np.mean(m):.4f}+/-{np.std(m):.4f}  {np.mean(h):.4f}+/-{np.std(h):.4f}')

print()
print('=== PER-SEED DETAIL (surprisal & binary-ours) ===')
print(f'{\"Run\":<30} {\"MMLU\":>8} {\"HellaSwag\":>10}')
print('-'*52)
for rn in sorted(seed_data.keys()):
    d = seed_data[rn]
    if d['strategy'] in ['base_model', 'binary-ours', 'surprisal', 'no-filter']:
        print(f'{rn:<30} {d[\"mmlu\"]:>8.4f} {d[\"hs\"]:>10.4f}')

print()
print('=== DELTA (surprisal - binary-ours) ===')
bo = results.get('binary-ours', {})
su = results.get('surprisal', {})
if bo.get('mmlu') and su.get('mmlu'):
    bm = np.mean(bo['mmlu']); sm = np.mean(su['mmlu'])
    bh = np.mean(bo['hellaswag']); sh = np.mean(su['hellaswag'])
    print(f'  binary-ours  MMLU={bm:.4f}  HS={bh:.4f}')
    print(f'  surprisal    MMLU={sm:.4f}  HS={sh:.4f}')
    print(f'  DELTA        MMLU={sm-bm:+.4f}  HS={sh-bh:+.4f}')
"

    seed_data[run_name] = {'mmlu': mmlu, 'hs': hs, 'strategy': strategy, 'seed': seed}

print('=== SUMMARY (mean +/- std) ===')
header = f"{'Strategy':<25} {'n':>3}  {'MMLU':>13}  {'HellaSwag':>13}"
print(header)
print('-' * 60)
for key in ['base_model', 'no-filter', 'binary-ours', 'binary-drayson', 'surprisal',
            'graduated_a0.1', 'graduated_a0.3', 'graduated_a0.5', 'graduated_a0.7', 'graduated_a0.9']:
    if key in results:
        m = results[key]['mmlu']
        h = results[key]['hellaswag']
        n = len(m)
        mm, ms = np.mean(m), np.std(m)
        hm, hs2 = np.mean(h), np.std(h)
        print(f'{key:<25} {n:>3}  {mm:.4f}+/-{ms:.4f}  {hm:.4f}+/-{hs2:.4f}')

print()
print('=== PER-SEED DETAIL ===')
print(f"{'Run':<30} {'MMLU':>8} {'HellaSwag':>10}")
print('-' * 52)
for rn in sorted(seed_data.keys()):
    d = seed_data[rn]
    if d['strategy'] in ['base_model', 'binary-ours', 'surprisal', 'no-filter']:
        mv = d['mmlu'] if d['mmlu'] is not None else 0
        hv = d['hs'] if d['hs'] is not None else 0
        print(f'{rn:<30} {mv:>8.4f} {hv:>10.4f}')

print()
